legalName: Petition for Expungement of Non-Conviction Summary Case Records Pursuant to Pa.R.Crim.P. 490
publicName: Expunge a Pennsylvania summary case that did not end in a conviction
mechanism: Rule 490 governs expungement in summary cases. Any case in which a summary offense was filed together with a misdemeanor, felony or murder charge proceeds under Rule 790 instead. The rule prescribes the petition contents, the attached Pennsylvania State Police criminal history report obtained within 60 days before filing, service on the attorney for the Commonwealth, and the expungement order.
exclusions: Any case in which a summary offense was filed together with a misdemeanor, felony or murder charge. Rule 490 expressly routes those cases to Rule 790.
Cases that moved to the court of common pleas.
Mixed cases in which any charge resulted in a conviction.
venue: The clerk of the courts of the judicial district in which the charges were disposed, for a case that remained at the magisterial district court.

destination.name: Clerk of the courts of the judicial district in which the charges were disposed
destination.detail: File the Rule 490 petition and blank expungement order. A copy is served on the attorney for the Commonwealth concurrently with filing, who has 30 days after service to file a consent or objection.

components.conditionDescription: Applies only where the participant seeks to proceed in forma pauperis at the magisterial district court level.

participantActionRequired.description: Obtain Pennsylvania State Police criminal history report obtained within 60 days before filing. Request your own criminal history report from the Pennsylvania State Police. Rule 490 requires a current copy obtained within 60 days before filing to be attached. LegalEase never collects, inspects or authenticates it.
Check your answer to "How did each charge end?" against Pennsylvania State Police criminal history report obtained within 60 days before filing, and correct the packet if they disagree.
Obtain Magisterial district court docket sheet. Obtain the docket sheet showing every charge and its disposition, and confirm no misdemeanour or felony was filed with the summary offences.

openLegalQuestions.question: Whether the attorney for the Commonwealth may waive the Pennsylvania State Police criminal history report requirement under Rule 490. Rules 790 and 791 state an express waiver; the current text of Rule 490 does not.
